Bhagavad Gita Chapter 18, Verse 70

मोक्षसंन्यासयोग

Shlok 70 (sloka 70) of adhyaya 18 — Moksha Sanyasa Yoga (मोक्षसंन्यासयोग), from the Bhagavad Geeta or Bhagavat Gita (भगवद्गीता). Open in Ask Krishna.

Open this verse in Ask Krishna

Sanskrit (Devanagari)

अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः |
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ||१८-७०||

English meaning

And he who will study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped by the sacrifice of wisdom, such is My conviction.

Hindi meaning

जो पुरुष, हम दोनों के इस धर्ममय संवाद का पठन करेगा, उसके द्वारा मैं ज्ञानयज्ञ से पूजित होऊँगा - ऐसा मेरा मत है।।
